items.new_text: When the operator creates a task through Fix now from a triage card or from its detail dialog, the triage item remembers that task: the card shows an In progress box with the task title, the task's current state and an Open task link, and the Fix now, Promote and Snooze buttons are replaced by a Resolve button.
The Triage summary tiles include an In progress tile that counts the open items whose remembered task is not yet done; selecting it narrows the list to those items and shows a removable chip.

When the operator presses the Dismiss cross on a triage card, a small popup asks for an optional reason and offers Dismiss and Cancel; nothing is dismissed until Dismiss is pressed, and the reason is stored the same way as when dismissing from the detail dialog.
The campaign source variant shows the same Campaign help text as the main campaign source, and a reviewable list of every Triage help text sits in the specification folder.
